Job Description

At Hacksaw Gaming, we believe that a clean, organized, and welcoming workplace helps create a great environment for everyone. We are looking for a reliable, trustworthy, and hardworking Office Maid to help maintain our office and support the team with light day-to-day tasks. Job Description: This position is primarily focused on keeping the office clean and well-maintained. In addition, you will assist management with small tasks such as running errands, organizing supplies, and preparing refreshments. Responsibilities: Sweep, mop, vacuum, dust, and clean all office areas; Clean and maintain restrooms, kitchen areas, and shared spaces; Empty and sanitize waste bins; Refill soap, tissues, and other hygiene products; Keep all rooms tidy, especially meeting areas and common zones; Run office-related errands, such as purchasing supplies or refreshments; Prepare tea, coffee, and light refreshments for staff when required; Assist with basic administrative tasks, such as filing or organizing documents; Support management with occasional day-to-day tasks when required. Requirements: Previous experience in a cleaning or similar role is preferred; Reliable, punctual, trustworthy, and responsible; Friendly, helpful attitude and willingness to assist when needed; Able to work independently and manage time well; Basic spoken English is an advantage.
